properties.name: Component coupling gets a typed call, and the cross-design pin gives up the name it was holding
properties.rationale:
Anthony's word, 2026-09-01: "I think we should change the declare_dependency --> external_dependency", overruling the recommendation that the rename follow later on a deprecation path. That is `rule:fix-it-properly-while-it-is-still-cheap`'s second clause applied as written — "it would break consumers" is a reason to do it NOW, and the deprecation discipline begins at 1.0.

FROM musicjug, 2026-08-31 (`fact:the-commonest-structural-edge-has-no-typed-helper-and-its-name-is-taken`): the session searched for a way to say one component depends on another, found the version-pinning tool by name, and fell back to a raw `create_edge`. The absence alone cost a raw write; the collision routed a searching agent to the wrong tool first, and `find_tools` ranks by name, so the misdirection was systematic rather than unlucky.

RENAMING THE CORE METHOD TOO WAS NOT COSMETIC: leaving `declare_dependency` in core behind a tool called `external_dependency` would have created exactly the helper-vs-core naming disagreement `fact:defect-typed-tool-parameter-names-are-inconsistent` has counted eleven of. This is the eleventh instance being closed rather than the twelfth being opened.

Pinned by four tests written first and OBSERVED FAILING IN TWO STAGES, which is what shows they discriminate: with the helper absent the file did not compile; with the helper added and the rename not yet done, the two helper tests PASSED and the two rename tests FAILED. The counterweight is `the_old_colliding_name_is_gone` — if the old name had survived alongside the new one, the collision would remain and the other rename test would still have passed. The rename is observed through `report_manual_work`, which asks the LIVE ROUTER rather than a hand-kept list.

⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO, said plainly because the temptation is to read it as more: it does not make any design better connected. Measured the day it landed, 1 of 70 of reflow2's own components carried any coupling, so modularity still reports "not measurable" rather than a score. This removes the excuse; the modelling stays the designer's work.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
TWO CHANGES, because the report was two defects that compound.

① ADDED `depends_on(from_id, to_id)` — `DesignGraph::depends_on` in graph.rs beside `allocate`, served from capture.rs. Draws `Component DEPENDS_ON Component`, the edge cycle detection, single-point-of-failure analysis and the undeclared-seam gap all read. It is a thin wrapper filling in endpoint types, which is all the other nine typed helpers are, and it refuses an absent endpoint exactly like them.

② RENAMED the cross-design version pin, which was holding that name. Served tool `declare_dependency` -> `external_dependency`; core `DesignGraph::declare_dependency` -> `declare_external_dependency`; request struct `DeclareDependencyReq` -> `ExternalDependencyReq`. The core keeps its verb because it reads as Rust; the served tool drops it because it reads as a noun beside `depends_on`, `allocate` and `satisfies`.

🛑 A BREAKING CHANGE TO A SERVED SURFACE, and the toolsnap goldens record it as one removed and one added so a reviewer sees exactly what moved.
